title: Juicy Pungent Venezuelan Egg White Casserole
description: A flavorful and nutritious Venezuelan-inspired casserole perfect for meal prep, featuring egg whites, a soffritto base, and a variety of spices.

ingredients.name: Soffritto
ingredients.notes: Chopped onion, garlic, and bell pepper

instructions: Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with olive oil.
In a large skillet, cook the soffritto over medium heat until softened.
Add the cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg whites and a pinch of salt.
Add the cooked soffritto mixture, chopped cilantro, and grated queso fresco to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the casserole is set and lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
